# Souq Arab EU / سوق العرب EU

> Arabic-first classified marketplace for buying, selling, and services in the European Union.

## Canonical site

- https://www.souq-arab.com/

## Languages

- Arabic (primary), English, German

## Public indexable pages

- Home: /
- Categories: /categories
- Search: /search
- Terms: /terms
- Privacy: /privacy
- Account deletion info: /delete-account
- Public ads: /ad/{id}
- Public seller profiles: /users/{id}

## Sitemaps

- https://www.souq-arab.com/sitemap.xml
- https://www.souq-arab.com/sitemap-ads.xml

## Structured data (schema.org JSON-LD)

- Homepage: Organization, WebSite, WebApplication
- Ad detail (approved public listings): Product, Offer

## Not for indexing

- /admin, /admin-login, /messages, /settings, /login, /signup, /new, /guest-welcome

## Legal

- Terms: https://www.souq-arab.com/terms
- Privacy: https://www.souq-arab.com/privacy
